subject: general
question: Which co-operative bank’s licence was cancelled by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) in May 2025 for capital shortfall?
solution:
The correct answer is __**HCBL Co-operative Bank**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** cancelled the license of **HCBL Co-operative Bank Ltd.**, based in **Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh**, in **May 2025**.
 
• The central bank stated that the co-operative bank ceased to have **adequate capital** and **earning prospects**, which is a violation of the provisions of **Section 11(1)** and **Section 22 (3)(d)** read with **Section 56** of the **Banking Regulation Act, 1949**.
 
• The bank was found non-compliant with the requirements of **Section 22(3) (a), (b), (c), (d) and (e)** of the **Banking Regulation Act**, making its continued operation prejudicial to the interests of its **depositors**.
 
• With the cancellation of its license, **HCBL Co-operative Bank** is strictly prohibited from conducting the **'business of banking'**, including the **acceptance and repayment of deposits**, effective immediately from the close of business hours on the date of the order.
